info.what: A small piece of code that runs only when something triggers it, with no server for you to manage.
info.why: You pay only while it runs, and it scales up and down automatically. Handy for occasional or spiky work.
info.analogy: Calling a taxi when you need one instead of owning a car.

samples.caption: A complete function: runs whenever a file is uploaded
It scales with demand on its own, down to zero
